checks.name: Viewport inversion retains a constant 64 screen-pixel overscan at all supported zooms
Closed viewport edges, negative coordinates and crossing segments are never culled by endpoint-only logic
Viewport hysteresis reuses edge objects but evicts beyond the retention margin and on document removal
Rotated bounds retain external pads, oversized drills and reference/pad text overhang
Copper stroke, shadow and via drill extents stay visible across the viewport edge
Immutable geometry reuses bounds and point arrays; replacement objects invalidate them without mutating source
Invalid geometry and invalid viewport fail open, including an empty trace
Raster allocation has per-part and per-scene caps with idempotent cleanup and vector fallback
